correctness.rationale: Finite connected graph gives almost-sure consensus in both traits. A two-lineage reverse ancestral Markov chain has six lumped categories with exact transition rates and unique stationary distribution. Its balance equations yield the listed masses and their normalization for all a,b>=1 including singleton cases. Duality plus finite-chain convergence gives the full terminal law. Independent full-forward absorbing chain tests passed 3,648 comparisons and 196 rational mass checks; tests supplement analytic proof.

value.rationale: The explicit full joint law and topology-sharp asymptotic ancestor coincidence provide a natural neutral-control diagnostic for jointly evolving game and strategy traits. On a star terminal binary correlation tends to 1/5 despite zero selection, whereas balanced graph ancestral linkage vanishes. This clarifies an important mechanistic limit on attributing observed association to selection, without conflating terminal and quasi-stationary laws.
